reasoning: On the season so far the Bulls are the stronger team; with home court the Bulls start about 3 points better, in a game of about 239 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 0 points towards the Bulls.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Bulls win 58 times in 100, by about 3; most games like this end between 210 and 259 total points.

analyst.text: Both teams are 6-12 and effectively out of the Cup picture. Indiana play the second night of a back-to-back after hosting Philadelphia, and Tyrese Haliburton's return from a hamstring strain is still unconfirmed. Chicago are without Norman Powell and Caleb Wilson but beat Charlotte on Wednesday behind Matas Buzelis. The schedule spot leans Chicago at home.
